properties.name: One test function renamed from a_declaration_retired_by_a_PROPOSED_decision_still_reports to ..._a_proposed_decision_... . The test's assertions, subject and meaning are untouched: it still pins that is_discontinued requires the withdrawing Decision to be ACCEPTED, so a proposed removal keeps reporting. The rename is a clippy non_snake_case fix — `cargo clippy -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` refused to compile the test target, and the narrower clippy invocation run in the prior session did not reach it. Nothing the design says about dependency reconciliation moved.
